{{Quote|Don't shrug off your role. The minstrel's song outlasts any truth, Cham. It holds more energy than any mere blaster bolt, for it cannot be stopped by a warm body.|Gobi Glie, to Cham Syndulla, on the power of a legend|<ref name="The Ballad of Cham Syndulla" />}}
The "'''Ballad of Cham Syndulla'''" was a [[Music/Legends|song]] written in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Music/Legends|minstrel]] [[Gobi Glie/Legends|Gobi Glie]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It honored Twi'lek [[Cham Syndulla/Legends|Cham Syndulla]], who formed and led the [[Twi'lek freedom fighters/Legends|freedom fighters]], a group of his supporters, to [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|combat]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] after its invasion and subjugation of Ryloth.

==Background==
{{Quote|You sing a song of a legend. I'm just a soldier, Gobi.''"<br />"''Soldiers, we have by the dozens and are still outnumbered. But our foes have no legends; that's where we dwarf them.|Cham Syndulla and Gobi Glie|<ref name="The Ballad of Cham Syndulla" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]]&mdash;the [[Foreman/Legends|foreman]] of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] and a member of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]]&mdash;sought to steal the treasures of fellow Council member, [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]]. Tambor had pilfered the treasures from Confederate-conquered worlds, and Argente had taken them to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] to be concealed.<ref name="Covetous">''[[The Clone Wars: Covetous]]''</ref>

Tambor invaded the planet and placed its [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] inhabitants under a harsh rule,<ref name="Storm Over Ryloth">{{TCW|Storm Over Ryloth}}</ref> and the Confederacy's subjugation of the world led the Twi'lek [[Cham Syndulla/Legends|Cham Syndulla]] to form a [[Twi'lek freedom fighters/Legends|group of his admirers]] for [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|combat]] against the Confederacy. Syndulla and his fighters [[Ground warfare/Legends|engaged]] the Confederate [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|forces]] on the plains of [[Cazne/Legends|Cazne]]. However, the resistance [[Death/Legends|lost many lives]], and the increasing number of Confederate [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] forced the Twi'leks to go into hiding. Syndulla and his forces took refuge under several destroyed Confederate [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] and [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|Multi-Troop Transports]] on the plains, although they continued to fight and ambush battle droid patrols.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref>

While they took shelter, Syndulla's friend, the Twi'lek [[Music/Legends|minstrel]] [[Gobi Glie/Legends|Gobi Glie]], composed the "Ballad of Cham Syndulla" to further inspire the freedom fighters' efforts. The song included Syndulla's antagonistic views of Ryloth's Twi'lek [[Senator/Legends|senator]], [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]],<ref name="The Ballad of Cham Syndulla" /> whom Syndulla believed to be uncaring of the Twi'leks' fate on Ryloth while he remained on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] capital of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], headquarters of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth" /> The ballad also illustrated Syndulla's exploits and leadership of the resistance, as well as the insurgency's first engagement with the Confederate forces at Cazne. Syndulla was opposed to the song and believed that it inaccurately portrayed him as a legend rather than an ordinary soldier, while Glie himself believed that the potential of inspirational leaders was an advantage that the Twi'leks had over the Confederate droids.<ref name="The Ballad of Cham Syndulla" />

==Lyrics==
[[File:Gobi2.png|thumb|right|220px|Gobi Glie, composer of the ballad]]
{{ExcerptIU|<poem>
''Huddle 'round, Ryloth children,''
''By history's wan light,''
''Hear now of the exploits of Cham Syndulla''

''Did you know, Ryloth children,''
''Of history's grand fight,''
''Of the villains sent scurrying by Cham Syndulla''

''Feared by the corrupt and loved by the free''
''Unshackling our Ryloth for you and for me''
''Spine stronger and straighter than time-tested spiree''
''He took the first stand 'gainst tyrants and liars''

"Ryloth for Twi'leks," ''his war-cry would haunt''
''The plump baron and leechee from far Coruscant''
''These words kept us starved and stole from our larder''
''But Cham said ''"No more''," kept filled by his ardor''

''So hear now, Ryloth children,''
''Of what was to come''
''Hear now of the challenge to Cham Syndulla''

''Do you hear, Ryloth children,''
''The Separatist war drum''
''And how it was answered by Cham Syndulla''

''A new war came to Ryloth, it dropped from the skies''
''An old greed, an old hunger, wrapped in a new guise''
''In the midst of our war 'gainst the rich for the poor''
''The terrible Clone Wars arrived at our door''

''Droids preyed on the innocents, the sick and the old''
''Mechanical murder, a murder most cold''
''It made no difference what flag our foes flew''
''For Cham rallied our forces, charging boldly anew''

''In our warrens, Ryloth children,''
''We gather and hide''
''But still hear the call of Cham Syndulla''

''We aren't lost, Ryloth children,''
''We will turn the tide''
''By following into battle Cham Syndulla''

''Our brothers have fallen, tread upon by steel feet''
''We buried their bodies, we tasted defeat''
''Though we have been pushed back, our resistance won't fall''
''We're twice again in might, with headtails to the wall''

''We will continue the fight, with blasters and knives''
''With teeth bared and fists balled, we fight for our lives''
''Cham will free Ryloth, our home soil we hold dear''
''He will bring us our victory and teach droids how to fear''

==Behind the scenes==
The "Ballad of Cham Syndulla" was structured in three sets of a refrain and two verses each. The refrains were composed of two three-line sections, following a rhyming pattern of ABCABC, while the verses were [[Wikipedia:Quatrain|quatrains]] and followed a rhyming pattern of AABB.<ref name="The Ballad of Cham Syndulla" />

The "Ballad of Cham Syndulla" was introduced in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' webcomic]] [[The Clone Wars: The Ballad of Cham Syndulla|of the same name]], which led directly into "[[Liberty on Ryloth]]," an episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode021.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref>
